description.value: Bonus to Perception and Will saves against illusions and mind-affecting effects that rely on a simulated or artificial environment — alongside the occasional unbidden déjà vu, a glitch in a world that was never quite real to begin with.

cinderfall.incomplete: The card states a bonus but gives no numeric value, bonus type, or specific action tag to build a FlatModifier from without inventing one. and the trigger ('illusions or mind-affecting effects that rely on a simulated or artificial environment') has no matching trait or roll option.
